newsitem.title: UK: Recent moves by economists in London's City.
newsitem.headline: Recent moves by economists in London's City.

text.p: The following list is a selection of economists and strategists who recently have moved jobs in the City, London's financial district.
-- Klaus Baader, formerly a senior currency economist at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, has taken up the same position at Lehman Brothers.
-- Ian Gunner, formerly an economist at Chase Investment Bank, has joined SBC Warburg to cover Germany.
-- Michael O'Hanlon, formerly chief international economist at PaineWebber, has become PaineWebber's head of international fixed income in London.
-- Ifty Islam, formerly European bond strategist at Merrill Lynch, has joined Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
-- Joe Prendergast, formerly foreign exchange strategist at Merrill Lynch, has joined Credit Suisse First Boston as head of global foreign exchange research and strategy.
